name: Winsome Textile Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1980, Winsome Textile Industries Ltd manufactures Cotton Yarn, Cotton Melange, Cotton Blended Dyed Yarn /Fibre, Yarn made of natural and manmade fibre and other fibres, Knitted Fabric, and Power generation in Textile Sector[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) WTIL is a producer of Yarns & Fabric for Knitting and Weaving in India and an exporter of Processed Yarn
b) Company is a manufacturer of Melange Yarn, Dyed yarn and spinning of large variety of value-added fibre, silk, wool, linen, nylon, PVA, etc. in different blends and specialty products like slub yarn, mélange yarn, gassed mercerized yarns, etc.
c) WTIL is also engaged in manufacturing of knitted fabric of various blend
d) It has also invested in Hydro Power Generation

pros: Stock is trading at 0.53 times its book value
Promoter holding has increased by 0.91% over last quarter.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.50% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 8.86% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
